decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.
Condition : 4 - The extension  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 190 Great West Road.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western or eastern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Informative; The applicant's attention is drawn to Condition 1 of this approval requiring the development to be commenced within one year of the date of this permission. You are advised that if this is not complied with the necessary enforcement action will be taken regarding the unauthorised side and rear extension.
description: Demolition of existing front extension and erection of two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and front porch.
